decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core charcuterie range and aligned with the firm's stated push into organic lines, management is likely to keep it and interpret any early weakness as temporary despite its lower website visibility.
Because this product fits both the organic strategy and assortment expansion, and was given its own webpage as a visible commitment, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although less central than the organic products, it is still close to the established offer, supports the firm's variety and new-format direction, and its dedicated webpage signals enough commitment for management to persist.
